run_summary: The research desk identified several official updates from the Japan Meteorological Agency regarding volcanic ash forecasts and weather warnings, alongside routine administrative announcements from JR Central and local tourism boards. No major travel-disrupting emergencies were identified.

candidates.title: Volcanic Ash Forecasts: Aso, Sakurajima, Satsuma-Iojima, Suwanosejima, and Kirishima
candidates.formal_status_basis: Routine scheduled ashfall forecasts provided by JMA; no new eruption or alert-level change reported.
candidates.what_changed: The Japan Meteorological Agency issued routine ashfall forecasts for five volcanoes in the Kyushu region.
candidates.why_it_matters: Travelers in these areas should be aware of potential ashfall, which can affect visibility, air quality, and local transport operations.
candidates.traveler_action: Check local weather reports and follow instructions from local authorities if ashfall occurs.
